result.decision_rationale:
The focused gate passed, and both frozen alpha packages are now traceable to their clean producing commit. Two evidence gaps remain in the enrollment handoff. The recorded denial abbreviates the command the classifier received, and the record of PR #69’s closure lacks a GitHub result.

Continuation for Claude

Make one records-only correction. Retrieve the complete command and its denial from the saved tool event without executing it. Pair the existing cancellation result with a retained GitHub closure event or a read-only status result for PR #69. The separate amendment and cap extension are already substantiated. Preserve the frozen packages and use the existing required gate and release budget for the corrected candidate.

executed_verification: The controller ran Test-Tiers.ps1 -Tier Fast -Focused Test-MountedShieldFocused.ps1 at 64abec49. The log matched the receipt’s SHA-256. The gate exited 0 in 67.6 seconds with both compiler-input checks passing, 1,525 component checks, 153 source checks and all 17 focused children passing. Release-budget spending ended at 13.67 of 30 minutes.

The retained standalone validator outputs report 12 passes for the main ZIP and 8 for the observer ZIP, with zero failures. Each output names the same ZIP SHA-256 as its qualification manifest. I matched both packaged Info.json hashes to the checkout and both DLL hashes and MVIDs to their static audits.
The static audits resolved 14 types and 42 members for the main DLL and 8 types and 20 members for the observer across UMM 0.31.1, 0.32.4, the owner’s 0.33.0 and 0.33.4.
I reproduced all seven committed-blob checksums in the release evidence index and the two original Windows audit checksums.
inspected: The mission, both owner amendments, repository validation policy, prior findings, developer report and controller evidence.

The supplied 97-file feature diff matched Git’s merge-base-to-candidate diff. The six files changed since round 11 are release evidence. Only documentation and evidence changed after the package-producing commit 7a9861a5.
Git ancestry preserves the accepted archive 20bf1351 and main 783b2b3d as the parents of integration merge 3e2c44a6. The archived PR #62 review records are unchanged.
limitations: The frozen ZIPs were outside the snapshot. Package verification relied on the retained qualification manifests, standalone validator outputs and DLL audits.
The controller withheld the mixed-session foreground transcript. Its supplied receipt covers the candidate gate. Live GitHub access was outside this review.
Native startup, gameplay, save/reload and combined-stack behavior remain untested on all four loader versions.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: Both qualification manifests name clean commit 7a9861a5 on codex/umm-0311-integration-20261126. Each lists exactly Info.json and its product DLL. The ZIP digests match the standalone validator outputs, and the DLL digests and MVIDs match the release audits.

The dated results establish that the amendment was admitted at the 10/10 cap at 16:18:24Z and a separate extension set the absolute cap to 13 at 16:18:36Z. The remaining item is the exact denied shell input, whose final command is summarized.

The cancellation excerpt identifies the correct #69 enrollment, zero completed reviews, no pending publications and #62 as the continuing route. The GitHub closure is still supported only by the developer’s account.
The index distinguishes Windows-output hashes from Git-blob hashes. Both audit files reproduce the values listed for each representation.
